title: Hi-Singers: A Comprehensive High-Quality Dataset for Expressive Audio-Driven Singing Head Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.22264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art models for audio-driven digital human generation have achieved photo-realistic results in talking-head synthesis. However, extending these models to singing-head synthesis remains challenging due to a significant Domain Gap: singing requires more exaggerated expressions, vivid jaw openings, and precise rhythmic synchronization. Current models, primarily trained on speech datasets, often struggle with "rhythmic drift" and constrained dynamics. To address this, we introduce Hi-Singers, the first large-scale, high-quality, in-the-wild video dataset specifically tailored for singing head synthesis. Hi-Singers undergoes a rigorous automated and manual filtering pipeline, ensuring strict thematic adherence, high-resolution rendering, and stable motion, resulting in 29,608 video segments totaling approximately 170 hours. We further establish a dedicated evaluation benchmark balanced across linguistic and musical styles. Exten

translated_title: Hi-Singers：一个用于富有表现力的音频驱动歌唱头部合成的全面高质量数据集
translated_abstract: 最先进的音频驱动数字人生成模型已经在说话头部合成中取得了照片级真实感的效果。然而，将这些模型扩展到歌唱头部合成仍然充满挑战，原因在于存在显著的领域差距：歌唱需要更夸张的表情、更生动的下颌张合以及精确的节奏同步。目前主要在语音数据集上训练的模型常常面临“节奏漂移”和动态受限的问题。为了解决这一问题，我们推出了Hi-Singers，这是首个专门为歌唱头部合成量身定制的大规模、高质量、真实场景视频数据集。Hi-Singers经过严格的自动化与人工筛选流程，确保了严格的主题契合度、高分辨率渲染和稳定的动作，最终包含29,608个视频片段，总时长约170小时。我们进一步建立了一个在语言和音乐风格上均衡分布的专用评估基准。
tldr: 提出了首个专为歌唱头部合成打造的大规模高质量真实场景视频数据集Hi-Singers（包含29,608个片段、约170小时），并建立了跨语言与音乐风格的专用评估基准，以弥合说话与歌唱合成之间的领域差距。
